title: Full or incremental: load orders with a watermark that misses nothing
objective_text: Load only what changed since the last run, update changed rows instead of doubling them, and move the watermark safely.
scenario: The nightly job reloads every order, and it now takes most of the night. The source keeps a modified_at time on each order. Change the load so it reads only what changed since the last run, without doubling any order and without losing tomorrow's place.
verifies: Your load adds new orders, updates changed ones, doubles nothing, and moves the watermark to the last change it loaded, on generated data on this PC.
does_not_verify: It doesn't run your MERGE on a Delta table in a Fabric lakehouse or a warehouse table, and it doesn't schedule the load in a pipeline.

expected.description: silver_orders holds orders 1 to 5 once each, order 2 complete, and the watermark is 2026-03-02 13:30.

hints: Read only the source rows with modified_at after the watermark in etl_watermark.
An INSERT adds a second row for order 2. MERGE INTO silver_orders ... ON order_id updates it instead.
After the MERGE, set high_water to max(modified_at) of what is now in silver_orders.
explanation: The load reads only rows with modified_at after the stored watermark, MERGEs them on order_id so changed orders are updated and new ones inserted, and then moves the watermark to the latest change it loaded. A full append doubles every order; an insert-only load doubles the changed ones; and a watermark that never moves makes every run read the same rows again.
reset: Reset rebuilds src_orders, silver_orders and etl_watermark from setup.sql and puts the starter back.
